lines.text: Coconut shells into charcoal briquettes: where's the money?
lines.phonemes: kˈoʊkənˌʌt ʃˈɛlz ˌɪntʊ tʃˈɑːɹkoʊl bɹɪkˈɛts: wˌɛɹz ðə mˈʌni?

lines.text: Collect discarded shells and dry them; wet loads waste fuel.
lines.phonemes: kəlˈɛkt dɪskˈɑːɹdᵻd ʃˈɛlz ænd dɹˈaɪ ðˌɛm; wˈɛt lˈoʊdz wˈeɪst fjˈuːəl.

lines.text: A drum kiln chars them with little air, then crush, bind with starch and press.
lines.tts: A drum kiln chars them with little air, then crush, bind with starch, and press.
lines.phonemes: ɐ dɹˈʌm kˈɪln tʃˈɑːɹz ðˌɛm wɪð lˈɪɾəl ˈɛɹ, ðˈɛn kɹˈʌʃ, bˈaɪnd wɪð stˈɑːɹtʃ, ænd pɹˈɛs.

lines.text: Say one batch makes 350 kilos: ₹10,500 in sales.
lines.tts: Say one batch makes three hundred fifty kilos: ten thousand five hundred rupees in sales.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪ wˈʌn bˈætʃ mˌeɪks θɹˈiː hˈʌndɹɪd fˈɪfti kˈiːloʊz: tˈɛn θˈaʊzənd fˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz ɪn sˈeɪlz.

lines.text: Shells, labour, energy, transport and equipment leave about ₹1,500, if shells come cheap.
lines.tts: Shells, labour, energy, transport, and equipment leave about fifteen hundred rupees, if shells come cheap.
lines.phonemes: ʃˈɛlz, lˈeɪbɚ, ˈɛnɚdʒi, tɹˈænspɔːɹt, ænd ɪkwˈɪpmənt lˈiːv ɐbˌaʊt fˈɪftiːn hˈʌndɹɪd ɹˈuːpiːz, ɪf ʃˈɛlz kˈʌm tʃˈiːp.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
